notes.title: Emi - Long Road Home
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I wanted to jump on really quick and let you all know about the new Emi game that's due out in December. It'll follow the events of New Beginnings. As many of you probably know, Emi will also be making an appearance in The Cabin too and this new game, Long Road Home, is Emi and the mc heading to The Cabin to face Hazel ( Although the mc of the Emi games chooses to stay away since he doesn't want to face her ).

A wishlist would be very much appreciated :)

notes.title: Emi - Christmas Special!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I just wanted to give a little update on Emi, as it's been a while since we last saw her. As a last-minute decision, we decided to make a Christmas special for her. And when I say last minute, I mean, I have less than a month to do all the art, which I'm not 100% confident I'll hit, so we're going to call this a Christmas-ish special. Maybe it'll be a New Year's special. But I have high hopes we'll meet the deadline :P

We'll also have another announcement coming for Emi in 2024, where we have a sequel in the works!

If you're interested in the Christmas special, be sure to add it to your wishlist, and maybe Santa will bring it in time :P

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700910/Emi__Christmas_Special/

notes.title: New Game Poll Results + Emi News
notes.notes:
The poll for the next game has now ended, and I have to say, it was close between game 1 and game 2, but game 2 just managed to sneak in the win.

Which means the next game I'll be working on is Adverse Effects. I have already started writing the story for it, and I'm about 2 days in so far, and the "feelings" are just about starting to kick in. I have changed how she gets the pills, thinking that it might open up the possibility of having sex with another character, but I'm not sure just yet; I'll need to see if I can work her into something sexual.

Keep in mind, though, that this will be my own solo story, and Wizard++ won't be working on it.

But, speaking of Wizard++, I have some news about him and about Emi.

The project that he was currently working on isn't quite panning out, so we've decided to put that one on hold for a little while and instead work on a sequel to Emi too. So we'll have Adverse Effects and Emi 2 coming out in the near future. We're not sure how long each will take, but keep an eye out for updates on both, and when we're at a point to start a Steam page for both, we'll update you here.

notes.title: Next Short Story Selection | You Decide
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

I posted a thread not long ago about possibly doing a preprequel to Emi, and a lot of people liked the idea, but some weren't so sure about it. Since not everyone was on board with the idea, I thought it best to delve into my folder of short story ideas (I have quite a few) and see which people would prefer for the next short story.

Something to keep in mind: I'll be working on the game alone since Wizard++ is working on The Cabin episode 4 and another short story with another developer. We both have to work a few different jobs to be able to keep working on these types of games, as I explained in the other thread.

So, without further ado, below you can find the three games I have in mind, and you can vote by commenting on the title of the game you'd prefer to see made.

[b]Game 1: Emi - College Days[/b]

Emi - College Days would be a preprequel to New Beginnings. A number of people liked the idea for this one in the other thread but for those who missed it, this is the idea. The game will follow Emi during a weekend at college. It'll take place during her second or third year after her has transitioned into her "new self" but she is still rather shy. Since this is a prequel to New Beginning and Emi lost her virginity in that game, College Days would need to follow a female protag ( Emi ) as she has an experimental weekend with Becky and 2 other friends. Since it is a female protag and Emi is a virgin, it can only have lesbian sex ( but will have strapons and such soooo kinda has a dick... :P ).

Key Tags:
[olist]
[*] Lesbian
[*] Female Protag
[/olist]

[b]Game 2: Adverse Effect[/b]
Adverse Effects follows a male main character but also shows certain things from a female character's perspective. The main characters "landlady" has recently had issues sleeping, so she decides to order some sleeping pills online, but there was a mixup at the pharmacy, and she receives some experimental drugs that boost her sex drive and pretty much makes her want to none-stop fuck the mc... :P

Key Tags:
[olist]
[*] Mature Female
[*] Male Protag
[*] Possible Pregnancy
[/olist]

[b]Lustful Checkup[/b]
Lustful Checkup also follows a male main character, who, just a little after his 18th birthday has to have a medical checkup ( a full body MOT ). The only issue for him, his doctor just happens to be his "landlady" and she has more than just a checkup planned.

Key Notes:
[olist]
[*] Mature Female
[*] Male Protag
[*] Option for Shy or Confident MC
[*] Possible Pregnancy
[/olist]

So those are the three possible game ideas that you can choose from. Like I said above, just comment on which game you'd prefer to see and whichever has the most votes in 5 days will win.

I'm also thinking the game will be around the same size as Emi, maybe a little larger and possibly will be priced at $2.99, depending on how the game turns out and how I feel about it, I might just go with $1.99 again, we'll see :P

notes.title: Emi - College Days | Discussion
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

I was recently chatting with someone in the discussions ( I won't name them in case they don't want me named, but you know who you are ), and we started a little conversation about a possible Emi prequel.

Now, for me, I've always considered the current game to be a prequel, as I have something much bigger planned that will take some time to get done. So I guess College Days would be a prequel of a prequel, a preprequel, if you will.

Anyway, I wanted to get more people's thoughts on the idea. I don't have a full idea for the game just yet, but I'm thinking it would follow Emi over a weekend at college where she, Becky, and a couple other female friends are having a wild weekend. It'll start a little after her transition, so she'll look like she did in New Beginnings but still be a lot more shy.

Something else to note is that since it follows Emi during her college days and she lost her virginity to the MC in that game, this new game would need to have a female protagonist (Emi) and also only contain lesbian content, which I know a lot of people are put off by, hence why I'm making this thread to see if people are actually interested in it.

Also, something else to note: Wizard++ has said he doesn't want to work on this game, so if I do make it, it'll just be me working on it (Cell), but fear not, I have plenty of free time to write it, and I think my grammar has improved a little since the last time I did a solo game, and I have a lot of confidence that I can make it happen.

Let me know your thoughts.

notes.title: In-Game Guide and Stat Tracker + The Future of Emi
notes.notes:
I've seen a few people asking for help in getting achievements so I was thinking it might be a good idea to add an in-game guide to show what options give you what stats and also add in a stat tracker so you can see what you have without having to use shift+o. 

Comment below if this is something you'd like. I know some people might not like it because it makes getting achievements a little easier. Comment if you do or don't want it and mojority will win.

As for the future of Emi. Things are in the works with her. We're not sure how we want to do it yet but we do plan on making a sequel with her. She'll also be making an appearance in our other game The Cabin. Also, Emi won't be getting a sequel until we have a decent amount of the cabin done. We're thinking up to episode 5 of the cabin needs to be finished before we do anything else with Emi.
